newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends little changed.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends little changed.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed little changed in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 604.73 from 604.56 on Wednesday.
Trade volume was 1.25 million dinars against 3.59 million dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF was up 1.11 dinar to 38.111 dinars. Banque du Sud won 0.66 dinar to 22.81 dinars.
UBCI bank eased 1.16 dinar to 50.34 dinars. ($=0.98 dinar)
